_comment: W2-adjacent: WAN 2.2 TI2V 5B text-to-video, API format, for content/ brand motion.
TI2V 5B is a SINGLE model - not the 14B hi/lo MoE pair the wan-t2v skill describes.
It pairs with wan2.2_vae.safetensors (NOT wan_2.1_vae) and umt5_xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled.
Parameterised per CONTENT_ENGINE.md 4: prompt (node 6), seed (node 10), size/length (node 8).
CONTENT_ENGINE.md 0: brand/abstract motion only. No food, no calorie numbers.
Tuned after v1 came out a near-static amber gradient: shift 8->5 for motion, concrete moving subject, hedging adverbs removed.
